cases.command:
mkdir -p /data/f4/sub1/skipme /data/f4/del && printf 'alpha inner
' > /data/f4/sub1/inner.txt && printf 'alpha skip
' > /data/f4/sub1/skipme/deep.txt && printf 'x
' > /data/f4/del/f1.tmp && printf 'y
' > /data/f4/del/f2.tmp && printf 'keep
' > /data/f4/del/keep.txt

find /data/f4/sub1 \( -name inner.txt -o -name deep.txt \); find /data/f4/sub1 -iwholename '*/SUB1/*.TXT' | sort; find /data/f4 -ipath '*SKIPME' ; find /data/f4/sub1 -wholename '*/inner.txt'; find /data/f4/sub1 -name '*.txt' -print -quit | wc -l; find /data/f4/sub1 -quit; find /data/f4/sub1 -quit -print; find /data/f4/sub1 /data/f4/sub1 -name inner.txt -print -quit; find /data/f4/sub1 -true -name inner.txt; find /data/f4/sub1 -false; echo rc=$?
